description: §17.6.2 / §17.6.1 — the value-form sugar at a BOUND (binding-site) position. `const label = if (@n > 0) { "pos" } else { "neg" }` binds the selected branch's expression WITHOUT a `lift`. `#out-sugar` renders 'pos'; `#out-lifted` writes the identical shape with an explicit `lift` in each branch and renders identically, pinning the §17.6.2 sugar equivalence at the binding site the way ctrl-021 pins it in a markup interpolation. `#out-cascade` pins an `else if` chain (@n is 5, so the 'mid' arm is selected — NOT the 'hi' arm and NOT the trailing 'lo' else). `#out-let` pins that a `let` binding site behaves identically to `const`, both being what §17.6.3 sanctions.
rationale: §17.6.1's grammar admits `arm-body ::= '{' expression '}'` as "value-form sugar for `{ lift expression }`", and §17.6.2 states it normatively: "An if-as-expression arm body SHALL produce its result value via a `lift` statement, **or** by being exactly one expression, which is sugar for `lift` of that expression (§17.6.10). These are the only two ways an arm body produces a value." Only the `lift` way was implemented at this position. A sugar arm fell through to the shared `bare-expr` handler, which under an active tilde context mints a FRESH `let _scrml_tilde_N = <expr>;` (the §32 pipeline-accumulator lowering) instead of writing the enclosing result var — so the result var stayed at its `= null` seed and the binding was ALWAYS `not`/null, at exit 0, with ZERO diagnostics (g-value-form-sugar-in-bound-position-emits-null, HIGH silent-wrong). This is a SILENT-WRONG regression guard: every `#out-*` selector below except `#out-lifted` and `#out-n` rendered EMPTY before the fix. The `#out-sugar` / `#out-lifted` pair is the load-bearing assertion — it pins the two forms to the same OBSERVABLE RESULT, which is what §17.6.2 asserts (§17.6.8 grants the compiler latitude over the emitted JavaScript, so this case does NOT assert emitted-code identity). `notCodes` carries W-LIFT-001 as a FORWARD guard: §17.6.2 says an arm body that IS exactly one expression "SHALL NOT surface W-LIFT-001"; that code has no emit site in compiler/src at the time this case was written, so the assertion is vacuous today and becomes load-bearing the moment W-LIFT-001 is implemented.
